name: Peach and Me
original_name: มีสติแล้วลูกพีช
overview:
Sequel of the Thai series - Me and Thee

After Thee and Peach's wedding, Thee resolves to finally get a grip. First, he takes Peach on six consecutive months of honeymoons, forcing Peach to ask for time off work. Meanwhile, Rome has to take over as leader of Arseni, and Thee turns his focus to his work at GMM THEEV.
